description: This is an HTML file for a web-based database viewer interface, containing styles, structure, and embedded JavaScript for dynamic data loading and interaction with backend APIs.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches and displays list of available databases from backend API.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases, resetting the UI state.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the list of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Loads and displays tables for a specific database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data from a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates and inserts HTML table from data into the container.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates table cell content with handling for long text and objects.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses table cell content for long or object data.
